title: W64 broad regression and release gate proof
purpose: Prove that W63 authority/MCP foundations survive broad release-critical CI, docs, security, schema, and runtime regression gates.

P1_primary: Map required CI workflows to release-critical functions: smoke, matrix, docs, security, canonicalization, DMAIC V3, and W62/W63 self-smoke.
Record current exact-head workflow names and expected pass/fail meanings.
Bind representative runtime tests to the W63 resolver, MCP, federation, and handover surfaces.
P2_reverse_pressure: Treat skipped, missing, or queued release-critical workflows as non-credit.
Detect green workflows that do not touch W63/W64 release-critical surfaces.
Escalate any failing workflow to a lane-specific repair PR rather than burying it in the release receipt.
P3_receipt: Emit a broad regression receipt with exact-head workflow ids, conclusions, and release relevance.
Separate advisory checks from blocking checks.
Block W64 DoV if any blocking workflow is red, missing, or stale.

acceptance_gates: Every blocking workflow has an exact-head run id and conclusion.
Representative W63 surfaces remain covered after W64 fan-out.
No release readiness claim is made from partial or stale CI evidence.
non_claims: Does not mark release candidate frozen.
Does not replace binary or census receipts.
Does not claim broad regression pass until exact-head workflows complete.
